نتكافر (form VI)
# نَتَكَافَرُ (natakāfaru) /na.ta.kaː.fa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَافَرَ (takāfara)
# نَتَكَافَرَ (natakāfara) /na.ta.kaː.fa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَافَرَ (takāfara)
# نَتَكَافَرْ (natakāfar) /na.ta.kaː.far/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَافَرَ (takāfara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
